title: Is Home Depot Open on Labor Day 2024? Details on Store Hours
text:
Is Home Depot Open on Labor Day 2024? Details on Store Hours

# Is Home Depot open on Labor Day 2024? What to know on store hours

Planning a home project? Find out what Home Depot's holiday hours are this Labor Day.

Tim Boyle / Getty Images

Sept. 1, 2024, 5:00 PM EDT / Updated Sept. 2, 2024, 8:54 AM EDT

By Sarah Lemire

That's a wrap on the Summer of 2024. Well, almost anyway.

While fall doesn't officially begin until later in September, the arrival of Labor Day usually symbolizes the end of the season, even if sweater weather is still a few weeks away.

Either way, it brings to mind all things autumn including leaf cleanup and other home projects. If you've got a few you'd like to tackle this weekend, you may be wondering if Home Depot is open on Labor Day this year.

While some retailers close in observance of the national holiday, many others remain open, offering all kinds of good deals and sales on back-to-school essentials, appliances and other seasonal items, including Halloween and the rest of the major holidays which, we might add, are just around the corner.

If Home Depot is your go-to retail destination, then you're in luck, because we've got everything you need to know on the retailer's holiday hours this year to ensure you've plenty of time to grab all the items on your shopping list.

From Labor Day store hours to providing a handy store locator to help you find a Home Depot near you, here are all the details.

## Is Home Depot open on Labor Day 2024?

Whatever you've got planned for Labor Day this weekend, whether it's painting the kitchen or getting a jumpstart on your fall decorating, you’ll be happy to know that, yes, The Home Depot will be open.

A Home Depot spokesperson confirms that stores will be open on the holiday during normal business hours. That said, it's always a good idea to confirm your local Home Depot's hours of operation before going to ensure you don't arrive to find an empty parking lot.

## Where’s a Home Depot near you?

If you’d like to check store hours or find the nearest Home Depot, we’ve got the retailer’s handy dandy store locator to save you the time of looking it up yourself. You’ll conveniently find it right here. 

## Other stores open on Labor Day 2024

Got some other shopping to do this Labor Day? Like Home Depot, most retailers welcome customers on Labor Day with many of them offering discounts and deals for back-to-school, as well as other necessities like appliances and mattresses.

Find a full list of retailers and grocery stores open on Labor Day, as well as their holiday hours right here.
